description: Basic native or OCR text of a PDF of up to 50 pages / 32 MiB, without review or structured tables. Up to 100 documents per agent. It does not open premium. Allowance per credential, until the earlier date of the agent's 30 days and the end of the pilot. Repeating the same document does not use another unit. Premium: keep evaluation.access_code and use X-Editalmd-Avaliacao together with X-Agent-Pass in the reads and in GET /geracao. Basic does not open premium content. The pilot depends on the global budget; no automatic renewal.

agent_pass.description: Persistent individual credential from POST https://api.editalmd.com/licitacoes/api/agente. It is not the User-Agent.

id.description: ID of the document in the collection.
